passiveSkills.name: Red-Nosed Reindeer
passiveSkills.desc: Significantly raises HP and nulls all status effects.

advancedSkills.name: Stardust Fencer
advancedSkills.desc:
A string of quick, successive attacks.
Deals dark type damage.

advancedSkills.name: Swift Lunge
advancedSkills.desc:
Take aim and release a long-range
lunging thrust. Hold to build up power
and deal greater damage.

advancedSkills.name: Energy Area
advancedSkills.desc:
A circular motion attack.
Creates an area where cooldown time
is reduced for Advanced Skills.
Effect is only granted within the area.

advancedSkills.name: Turbulence
advancedSkills.desc:
Unleashes a string of dual-handed spear
attacks.

advancedSkills.name: Heavy Attack
advancedSkills.desc: Stronger than a Normal Attack. An input after a Normal Attack combo will branch into a Combo Finish. Hold the button to unleash Bouncer, a V-shaped slicing attack.
